title: Normalized whole-tower comparison of the two integral pullbacks
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $T$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]; such schemes are called allowed. For each finite $E\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, use the framework integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^s(T)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and the PBC integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^p(T)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category].
For every scheme $W$ satisfying the same hypotheses, suppose $I_{W,E}$ is the integral identity equivalence and $J_{W,E}$ its exact raw rationalization, with the identity formulas on integral objects and tensor morphisms. Use the specified completion inverses $j_{W,L/E}=\chi_{L/E}^{-1}[1/\varpi_L]$ and the normalized framework scalar associators of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Write $F^s_{h,E}$ and $F^p_{h,E}$ for the actual integral completed pullbacks of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. For all scheme isomorphisms $h:U\xrightarrow{\sim}T$ between allowed schemes, simultaneously for all finite $E$, there are natural integral isomorphisms
$$b^{\mathrm{int}}_{h,E}:I_{U,E}F^s_{h,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^p_{h,E}I_{T,E}.$$
On a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$ they are the realization of the identity on the entire strict tower
$$Q_{h,E}(P)_n=\operatorname{Res}_n h_n^*(P\otimes_{R_{E,T}}(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_T),$$
with its actual quotient transitions. The product-cone and K-injective-derived-limit realizations are identified by the natural Roos map $\lim I_\bullet\to\operatorname{Cone}(1-s_I)[-1]$, $z\mapsto(0,z)$, for a tower K-injective replacement $Q\to I$. This comparison is independent of representatives and resolutions and restricts to the integral constructible categories. Its inverse, ambient lift and raw rationalization give the finite datum of [def-fd-finite-pullback-comparison-datum], including its actual unit-section chain map and zero shifted coordinate.
These choices are simultaneous with a whole-diagram realization system of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. For identity maps the unit equation is
$$u^p I\circ b^{\mathrm{int}}_{1}=Iu^s.$$
For $h:U\simeq V$, $k:V\simeq T$, with the specified comparisons $c^s,c^p:F_{kh}\to F_hF_k$, the equation is
$$c^p I\circ b^{\mathrm{int}}_{kh}=(F_h^p b^{\mathrm{int}}_k)\circ(b^{\mathrm{int}}_h F_k^s)\circ(Ic^s).$$
The source comparisons are exactly the whole-tower counit-normalized ones and the target comparisons are the actual PBC ones. For scalar change let $\alpha^s:S_UF^s_{h,E}\to F^s_{h,L}S_T$ and $\alpha^p:P_UF^p_{h,E}\to F^p_{h,L}P_T$ be the specified comparisons, now rationalized, and write $b_{h,E}$ for the rationalization of $b^{\mathrm{int}}_{h,E}$. Then
$$F^p_{h,L}(j_T)\circ b_{h,L,S_TK}\circ J_{U,L}(\alpha^s_K)=\alpha^p_{J_{T,E}K}\circ P_U(b_{h,E,K})\circ j_{U,F^s_{h,E}K}.$$
The corresponding integral equation uses the specified completion maps. All these equations respect shifts, repeated fields, successive coefficient extension and arbitrary finite scheme compositions, as equalities of whole quotient diagrams before realization, with their tower counits retained.
